name: Hornero World Clock
description: World Clock 2.0: dashboard card with local, UTC and three selectable cities. Pure-JS rule-based offsets (fixed, EU, US and southern DST rules) labelled per row; no processes or network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Time and Agenda 2.0: dashboard card (Time category) on the shared Time facade with no own timer, three selectable city slots (defaults Buenos Aires, Madrid, Tokyo as in 1.x), EU/US/southern DST rules with per-row offset and DST labels, locale dates, typed settings and Argentine Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card showing local time, UTC, and Buenos Aires, Madrid and Tokyo with pure-JS offsets (Madrid followed the EU DST rule).

city1.description: First city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city2.description: Second city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

city3.description: Third city row. Only zones with a built-in DST rule are offered.

showLocal.description: Show the local time row (the 1.x behaviour).

showSeconds.description: Show seconds in every row (the 1.x behaviour).

twentyFourHour.description: Use 24-hour times (the 1.x behaviour); off shows 12-hour AM/PM.
